body:
GO on dropping BUG-2531 from p15. Advisor ruling, 2026-11-15 23:55 MST.

Conditions:
1. Revert #4038 (efc9261) on integration with a merge-safe revert commit. No rebase and no force-push of integration.
2. The revert gives #4128 a new head, so its earlier verdict does not carry over. Re-gate it and get a fresh independent review at the new head. Review scope: does the revert remove exactly BUG-2531, and does TASK-3797 still stand alone?
3. Ship p15, then p16 (#4112 TASK-3123, #4120 BUG-2588, #4122 BUG-2603) by the normal train. Re-check p16's gate after p15 lands (tmp/integration-p16 1b0f665 was gated on the old base).
4. BUG-2531 is already routed back to its lane (queue rework, implementer). The six findings in aida review verdict PR-4128 are the rework brief; its next PR counts as round 2 of 4 (the cap is now 4).
5. Comment on BUG-2531 that it was pulled from p15 and why.
subject: Re: p15 decision: GO sent to integration seat
